# Weapon registry

`src/weapondefs.qc` is the single source of truth, initialised once from `worldspawn` (SVQC) and once from `CSQC_Init` (CSQC).

Two identifier spaces that are easy to confuse:

- **`WID_*`** — small integer IDs, `1..WID_COUNT-1`. Doubles as the impulse number, so `impulse 3` is `WID_PYTHON`.
- **`WEAPON_*`** — 32-bit **bitflags**, the on-the-wire format for `STAT_WEAPONS` and `self.weapon`.

They are *not* interchangeable. Convert with `Weapon_BitFromID(id)` and `Weapon_IDFromBit(bit)`.

| WID | # | Name | Slot | Pos | `WEAPON_*` bit | Value |
| --- | ---: | --- | ---: | ---: | --- | ---: |
| `WID_NONE` | 0 |  |  |  | `` |  |
| `WID_CROWBAR` | 1 | Crowbar | 1 | 0 | `WEAPON_CROWBAR` | 1 |
| `WID_GLOCK` | 2 | 9mm Handgun | 2 | 0 | `WEAPON_GLOCK` | 2 |
| `WID_PYTHON` | 3 | .357 Magnum | 2 | 1 | `WEAPON_PYTHON` | 4 |
| `WID_MP5` | 4 | 9mm AR | 3 | 0 | `WEAPON_MP5` | 8 |
| `WID_SHOTGUN` | 5 | Shotgun | 3 | 1 | `WEAPON_SHOTGUN` | 64 |
| `WID_CROSSBOW` | 6 | Crossbow | 3 | 2 | `WEAPON_CROSSBOW` | 32 |
| `WID_HANDGRENADE` | 7 | Hand Grenade | 5 | 0 | `WEAPON_HANDGRENADE` | 2048 |
| `WID_RPG` | 8 | RPG | 4 | 0 | `WEAPON_RPG` | 128 |
| `WID_SATCHEL` | 9 | Satchel Charge | 5 | 1 | `WEAPON_SATCHEL` | 8192 |
| `WID_TRIPMINE` | 10 | Trip Mine | 5 | 2 | `WEAPON_TRIPMINE` | 4096 |
| `WID_GAUSS` | 11 | Tau Cannon | 4 | 1 | `WEAPON_GAUSS` | 256 |
| `WID_EGON` | 12 | Gluon Gun | 4 | 2 | `WEAPON_EGON` | 512 |
| `WID_HORNETGUN` | 13 | Hornet Gun | 4 | 3 | `WEAPON_HORNETGUN` | 1024 |
| `WID_SNARK` | 14 | Snark | 5 | 3 | `WEAPON_SNARK` | 16384 |
| `WID_CYCLER` | 15 | Weapon Cycler | 1 | 1 | `WEAPON_CYCLER` | 16 |

Adding a weapon: bump `WID_COUNT`, add the `#define WID_FOO`, add an init block in `Weapon_RegistryInit()`, and reuse or add a `WEAPON_*` bit. The per-weapon select dispatch in `serverqc/weapons/weapons.qc` `Weapon_Update()` stays an explicit `if` chain — it is the one function-pointer hookup point.
